title: Token Importance-Aware Semantic Communication Enabled Robust Video Transmission
abstract: arXiv:2611.12928v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video applications are increasingly prevalent, yet their high data volume and temporal dependency make robust wireless transmission challenging under limited communication resources. To address this issue, we propose a token importance-aware semantic communication (Ti-SemCom) framework for bandwidth-efficient video transmission. Specifically, object and motion information is jointly extracted to identify communication-relevant regions, which are hierarchically associated with semantic tokens according to their importance. The transmitted tokens are then dynamically selected based on both token importance and the available bandwidth, prioritizing more informative video content under resource constraints. At the receiver, untransmitted regions reuse recently reconstructed references to further reduce redundant transmission. translated_title: 基于令牌重要性感知语义通信的鲁棒视频传输
translated_abstract: 视频应用日益普及，但其高数据量和时间依赖性使得在有限通信资源下实现鲁棒的无线传输颇具挑战。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种面向带宽高效视频传输的令牌重要性感知语义通信框架。具体而言，该方法联合提取目标与运动信息以识别与通信相关的区域，并根据重要性将这些区域与语义令牌进行分层关联；随后基于令牌重要性和可用带宽动态选择待传输的令牌，在资源受限条件下优先传输信息量更大的视频内容。在接收端，未被传输的区域复用最近重建的参考内容，从而进一步减少冗余传输。在CAVIAR数据集上的实验表明，Ti-SemCom能够实现88.3%的通信开销降低（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出令牌重要性感知的语义通信框架Ti-SemCom，通过联合提取目标与运动信息、按重要性分层关联语义令牌、结合带宽动态选择传输令牌并在接收端复用参考内容，在保证视频传输鲁棒性的同时将通信开销降低88.3%。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Ti-SemCom, a token importance-aware semantic communication framework that jointly extracts object and motion information, hierarchically associates regions with semantic tokens by importance, dynamically selects tokens for transmission based on bandwidth, and reuses receiver-side references, achieving an 88.3% reduction in communication cost for robust video transmission.
